from pathlib import Path
import re
from urllib.parse import unquote
files = [Path('docs/philosophy.md'), Path('docs/README.md'), Path('docs/architecture.md'), *Path('docs/adrs').glob('*.md')]
checked = 0
for page in files:
    for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)', page.read_text()):
        if '://' in target:
            continue
        name, _, anchor = target.partition('#')
        dest = page.parent / unquote(name) if name else page
        assert dest.exists(), (page, target)
        if anchor:
            headings = re.findall(r'^#+ (.+)$', dest.read_text(), re.M)
            slugs = [re.sub(r'[^\w\- ]', '', h.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for h in headings]
            assert anchor in slugs, (page, target)
        checked += 1
assert '[[fill:' not in Path('docs/philosophy.md').read_text()
print(f'Checked {checked} local links, including heading anchors; no unfilled template fields.')
